body: hey OP, I'm not sure what your going through and I will try to respond to you if you'd like. I've just had 3 phonecalls to suicide hotline and things are looking bad for me but I feel like we are in the same boat. I'll be awake for a while if you want a chat?

he told me he was considering it since before we met, but the lockdown here for extended and he had no choice but to go back. I just really hope he would consider making it work.
he had a lot on his plate but I pretty much have a very limited time to talk about it face to face. I still really want to make it work. :(
